```{r Setup}
source("./code/toonCat_analysisSetup.R")
output_directory <- "./results/figures/fig6"
```

```{r}
# ---- Polar fingerprint (clockwise; split Y into Ypos/Yneg) ----
# Adults = filled polygon (solid, underneath)
# Adolescents = dotted outline (on top)
# Needs:
#   df.centers_cat: ROI, hemi (lh/rh), group (adolescents/Adults), centerY, centerR, size
#   df.fig4 OR df.cat_FWHM: ROI, hemi, group, fwhm
#   df.ROIsize_cat_latdors: ROI, hemi, group, totalvox
# Writes: <output_directory>/fig3/fingerprint_polar_clockwise_ROIsize.png

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(stringr); library(ggplot2); library(fs); library(purrr)
})

# ---------- output dir ----------
if (!dir_exists(output_directory)) dir_create(output_directory)
out_dir <- file.path(output_directory); if (!dir_exists(out_dir)) dir_create(out_dir)

# ---------- ROI order (Words → Bodies → Faces → Places; ventral then lateral/dorsal) ----------
roi_levels <- c(
  # Words (ventral)
  "pOTS_words","mOTS_words",
  # Bodies (ventral → lateral)
  "OTS_bodies","LOS_limbs","ITG_limbs","MTG_limbs",
  # Faces (ventral → lateral)
  "IOG_faces","pFus_faces","mFus_faces","pSTS_faces",
  # Places (ventral → lat/dorsal)
  "CoS_places","MOG_places","IPS_places"
)

# ---------- colors by category × group ----------
pal_faces  <- c(Adults="#8B0000", adolescents="#FF0000")
pal_bodies <- c(Adults="#BA8E23", adolescents="#E4CD04")
pal_places <- c(Adults="#013220", adolescents="#008000")
pal_words  <- c(Adults="#000066", adolescents="#2323FF")

# ---------- axis maxima (display ranges) ----------
y_lim    <- 6
ecc_lim  <- 12
size_lim <- 30
fwhm_lim <- 30
vox_lim  <- 750  # <-- fixed ROI size range
vox_lim_disp <- 750

clamp  <- function(x, lo, hi) pmax(pmin(x, hi), lo)
deg2rad <- function(a) a*pi/180

# ---------- spoke directions (clockwise, start at Ypos) ----------
# Ypos=+90°, ROIvox=+45°, Ecc=-45°, Yneg=-90°, Size=-135°, FWHM=+135°
ang  <- c(Ypos=90, ROIvox=45, Ecc=-45, Yneg=-90, Size=-135, FWHM=135)
spokes <- tibble(axis=names(ang), cx=cos(deg2rad(ang)), sy=sin(deg2rad(ang)))

# ---------- helpers ----------
cat_from_roi <- function(roi){
  case_when(
    str_detect(roi, "words")            ~ "words",
    str_detect(roi, "limbs|bodies")     ~ "bodies",
    str_detect(roi, "faces")            ~ "faces",
    str_detect(roi, "places")           ~ "places",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )
}

# ---------- MEANS from centers (Y, Ecc, Size) ----------
core_means <- df.centers_cat %>%
  filter(hemi %in% c("lh","rh"),
         group %in% c("adolescents","Adults")) %>%
  mutate(ROI = str_trim(as.character(ROI))) %>%
  filter(ROI %in% roi_levels) %>%
  group_by(ROI, hemi, group) %>%
  summarise(
    y    = mean(centerY, na.rm = TRUE),
    ecc  = mean(centerR,  na.rm = TRUE),
    size = mean(size,     na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------- FWHM (prefer df.fig4, else df.cat_FWHM) ----------
fwhm_src <- if (exists("df.fig4")) df.fig4 else df.cat_FWHM
fwhm_means <- fwhm_src %>%
  filter(hemi %in% c("lh","rh"),
         group %in% c("adolescents","Adults")) %>%
  mutate(ROI = str_trim(as.character(ROI))) %>%
  filter(ROI %in% roi_levels) %>%
  group_by(ROI, hemi, group) %>%
  summarise(fwhm = mean(fwhm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ---------- ROI SIZE (voxels) from df.ROIsize_cat_latdors ----------
roi_size_means <- df.ROIsize_cat_latdors %>%
  filter(hemi %in% c("lh","rh"),
         group %in% c("adolescents","Adults")) %>%
  mutate(ROI = str_trim(as.character(ROI))) %>%
  filter(ROI %in% roi_levels) %>%
  group_by(ROI, hemi, group) %>%
  summarise(totalvox = mean(totalvox, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ---------- Join & clamp ----------
mean_df <- core_means %>%
  inner_join(fwhm_means,     by = c("ROI","hemi","group")) %>%
  inner_join(roi_size_means, by = c("ROI","hemi","group")) %>%
  mutate(
    ROI   = factor(ROI, levels = roi_levels, ordered = TRUE),
    hemi  = factor(hemi, levels = c("lh","rh")),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("Adults","adolescents")),  # Adults under, adolescents over
    y     = clamp(y, -y_lim, y_lim),
    ecc   = pmin(ecc,  ecc_lim),
    size  = pmin(size, size_lim),
    fwhm  = pmin(fwhm, fwhm_lim),
    vox   = pmin(totalvox, vox_lim),
    category = cat_from_roi(as.character(ROI)),
    line_col = case_when(
      category == "faces"  ~ pal_faces[as.character(group)],
      category == "bodies" ~ pal_bodies[as.character(group)],
      category == "places" ~ pal_places[as.character(group)],
      category == "words"  ~ pal_words[as.character(group)],
      TRUE ~ "#555555"
    )
  )

# ---------- Split Y into Ypos/Yneg, normalize all spokes to 0..1 ----------
norm_df <- mean_df %>%
  transmute(
    ROI, hemi, group, line_col,
    r_Ypos  = pmax(y, 0)  / y_lim,
    r_Yneg  = pmax(-y, 0) / y_lim,
    r_Ecc   = ecc  / ecc_lim,
    r_Size  = size / size_lim,
    r_FWHM  = fwhm / fwhm_lim,
    r_ROIvx = vox  / vox_lim
  )

# ---------- Build polygon points (clockwise: Ypos → ROIvox → Ecc → Yneg → Size → FWHM → Ypos) ----------
axes_order <- c("Ypos","ROIvox","Ecc","Yneg","Size","FWHM")

build_one_poly <- function(row) {
  vals <- c(
    Ypos = row$r_Ypos, ROIvox = row$r_ROIvx, Ecc = row$r_Ecc,
    Yneg = row$r_Yneg, Size   = row$r_Size,  FWHM = row$r_FWHM
  )
  df <- tibble(axis = axes_order, r = as.numeric(vals[axes_order])) %>%
    left_join(spokes, by = "axis") %>%
    mutate(x = r * cx, y = r * sy)
  bind_rows(df, df[1, , drop = FALSE]) %>%  # close polygon
    mutate(ROI = row$ROI, hemi = row$hemi, group = row$group, line_col = row$line_col)
}

poly_pts <- norm_df %>%
  arrange(ROI, hemi, group) %>%
  split(list(norm_df$ROI, norm_df$hemi, norm_df$group), drop = TRUE) %>%
  purrr::map_dfr(~ build_one_poly(.x[1, ]))

# Endpoints (drop the closing duplicate row)
end_pts <- poly_pts %>%
  group_by(ROI, hemi, group) %>%
  mutate(idx = row_number()) %>%
  filter(idx < max(idx)) %>%
  select(-idx) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---------- rings, rays, labels ----------
axes_df <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  ROI  = factor(roi_levels, levels = roi_levels, ordered = TRUE),
  hemi = factor(c("lh","rh"), levels = c("lh","rh"))
)

rings <- tibble(r = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0)) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(theta = seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 361)) %>%
  mutate(x = r * cos(theta), y = r * sin(theta)) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(axes_df)

rays <- spokes %>%
  mutate(x0 = 0, y0 = 0, x1 = cx, y1 = sy) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(axes_df)

end_labels <- bind_rows(
  tibble(axis="Ypos",   lab=sprintf("%d",  y_lim),        x=cos(deg2rad( 90)),  y=sin(deg2rad( 90))),
  tibble(axis="Yneg",   lab=sprintf("%d", -y_lim),        x=cos(deg2rad(-90)),  y=sin(deg2rad(-90))),
  tibble(axis="Ecc",    lab=sprintf("%d",  ecc_lim),      x=cos(deg2rad(-45)),  y=sin(deg2rad(-45))),
  tibble(axis="ROIvox", lab=sprintf("%d",  vox_lim_disp), x=cos(deg2rad( 45)),  y=sin(deg2rad( 45))),
  tibble(axis="FWHM",   lab=sprintf("%d",  fwhm_lim),     x=cos(deg2rad(135)),  y=sin(deg2rad(135))),
  tibble(axis="Size",   lab=sprintf("%d",  size_lim),     x=cos(deg2rad(-135)), y=sin(deg2rad(-135)))
) %>% tidyr::crossing(axes_df)

lab_hjust <- function(x) ifelse(x < -1e-6, 1.05, ifelse(x > 1e-6, -0.05, 0.5))
lab_vjust <- function(y) ifelse(y >  1e-6, -0.35, ifelse(y < -1e-6, 1.35, 0.5))

# ---------- draw ----------
n_cols <- length(roi_levels); n_rows <- 2
panel_w_in <- 1.9; panel_h_in <- 1.9
w_in <- n_cols*panel_w_in + 1.2; h_in <- n_rows*panel_h_in + 1.2

if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly=TRUE)) {
  ragg::agg_png(file.path(out_dir, "F6_fingerprint_polar_clockwise_teensFilled.png"),
                width=w_in, height=h_in, units="in", res=300)
} else {
  png(file.path(out_dir, "fingerprint_polar_clockwise_ROIsize.png"),
      width=w_in, height=h_in, units="in", res=300)
}

ggplot() +
  # rings & rays
  geom_path(data = rings, aes(x = x, y = y, group = interaction(r, ROI, hemi)),
            color = "gray75", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(data = rays, aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1),
               color = "gray75", linewidth = 0.6) +
  # axis-end labels
  geom_text(data = end_labels, aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab),
            size = 6, color = "gray35",
            vjust = lab_vjust(end_labels$y),
            hjust = lab_hjust(end_labels$x)) +
  # adolescents = filled polygon, no outline
  geom_polygon(
    data = poly_pts %>% dplyr::filter(group == "adolescents"),
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = interaction(ROI, hemi, group), fill = line_col),
    color = NA, alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  # Adults = solid outline only
  geom_path(
    data = poly_pts %>% dplyr::filter(group == "Adults"),
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = interaction(ROI, hemi, group), colour = line_col),
    linewidth = 1.7, lineend = "round", linetype = "solid"
  ) +
  # endpoints (same colors)
  geom_point(
    data = end_pts,
    aes(x = x, y = y, colour = line_col),
    size = 2, stroke = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-1.12, 1.12), ylim = c(-1.12, 1.12), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  facet_grid(hemi ~ ROI, drop = TRUE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_blank(),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    axis.text        = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks       = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x  = unit(1.4, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y  = unit(5, "lines"),
    plot.margin      = margin(10, 24, 10, 24)
  )

dev.off()

```

```{r}
# ---- Polar fingerprint (clockwise; split Y into Ypos/Yneg) ----
# Adults = solid line (solid, underneath)
# Adolescents = filled  (on top)
# Needs:
#   df.centers_cat: ROI, hemi (lh/rh), group (adolescents/Adults), centerY, centerR, size
#   df.fig4 OR df.cat_FWHM: ROI, hemi, group, fwhm
#   df.ROIsize_cat_latdors: ROI, hemi, group, totalvox
# Writes: <output_directory>/F6_fingerprint_polar_clockwise_ROIvxRel.png

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(stringr); library(ggplot2); library(fs); library(purrr)
})

# ---------- output dir ----------
if (!dir_exists(output_directory)) dir_create(output_directory)
out_dir <- file.path(output_directory); if (!dir_exists(out_dir)) dir_create(out_dir)

# ---------- ROI order (Words → Bodies → Faces → Places; ventral then lateral/dorsal) ----------
roi_levels <- c(
  # Words (ventral)
  "pOTS_words","mOTS_words",
  # Bodies (ventral → lateral)
  "OTS_bodies","LOS_limbs","ITG_limbs","MTG_limbs",
  # Faces (ventral → lateral)
  "IOG_faces","pFus_faces","mFus_faces","pSTS_faces",
  # Places (ventral → lat/dorsal)
  "CoS_places","MOG_places","IPS_places"
)

# ---------- colors by category × group ----------
pal_faces  <- c(Adults="#8B0000", adolescents="#FF0000")
pal_bodies <- c(Adults="#AB6B00", adolescents="#FFB302")
pal_places <- c(Adults="#013220", adolescents="green")
pal_words  <- c(Adults="#000066", adolescents="#2323FF")

# ---------- axis maxima (display ranges) ----------
y_lim    <- 6
ecc_lim  <- 12
size_lim <- 30
fwhm_lim <- 30

# ROI size normalization (relative to Adults within each ROI × hemi)
# Adults = 1.0 (100%). We map [vox_rel_lo, vox_rel_hi] -> [0, 1] on the spoke.
vox_rel_lo <- 0.50   # 50% of adult size -> radius 0
vox_rel_hi <- 1.50   # 150% of adult size -> radius 1
vox_rel_label_max <- sprintf("%d", round(100 * vox_rel_hi))  # for axis-end label

clamp   <- function(x, lo, hi) pmax(pmin(x, hi), lo)
deg2rad <- function(a) a*pi/180

# ---------- spoke directions (clockwise, start at Ypos) ----------
# Ypos=+90°, ROIvox=+45°, Ecc=-45°, Yneg=-90°, Size=-135°, FWHM=+135°
ang  <- c(Ypos=90, ROIvox=45, Ecc=-45, Yneg=-90, Size=-135, FWHM=135)
spokes <- tibble(axis=names(ang), cx=cos(deg2rad(ang)), sy=sin(deg2rad(ang)))

# ---------- helpers ----------
cat_from_roi <- function(roi){
  case_when(
    str_detect(roi, "words")            ~ "words",
    str_detect(roi, "limbs|bodies")     ~ "bodies",
    str_detect(roi, "faces")            ~ "faces",
    str_detect(roi, "places")           ~ "places",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )
}

# ---------- MEANS from centers (Y, Ecc, Size) ----------
core_means <- df.centers_cat %>%
  filter(hemi %in% c("lh","rh"),
         group %in% c("adolescents","Adults")) %>%
  mutate(ROI = str_trim(as.character(ROI))) %>%
  filter(ROI %in% roi_levels) %>%
  group_by(ROI, hemi, group) %>%
  summarise(
    y    = mean(centerY, na.rm = TRUE),
    ecc  = mean(centerR,  na.rm = TRUE),
    size = mean(size,     na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---------- FWHM (prefer df.fig4, else df.cat_FWHM) ----------
fwhm_src <- if (exists("df.fig4")) df.fig4 else df.cat_FWHM
fwhm_means <- fwhm_src %>%
  filter(hemi %in% c("lh","rh"),
         group %in% c("adolescents","Adults")) %>%
  mutate(ROI = str_trim(as.character(ROI))) %>%
  filter(ROI %in% roi_levels) %>%
  group_by(ROI, hemi, group) %>%
  summarise(fwhm = mean(fwhm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ---------- ROI SIZE (voxels) from df.ROIsize_cat_latdors ----------
roi_size_means <- df.ROIsize_cat_latdors %>%
  filter(hemi %in% c("lh","rh"),
         group %in% c("adolescents","Adults")) %>%
  mutate(ROI = str_trim(as.character(ROI))) %>%
  filter(ROI %in% roi_levels) %>%
  group_by(ROI, hemi, group) %>%
  summarise(totalvox = mean(totalvox, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Adult baseline per ROI × hemi (for relative normalization)
adult_vox_base <- roi_size_means %>%
  filter(group == "Adults") %>%
  select(ROI, hemi, adult_vox = totalvox)

# ---------- Join & clamp ----------
mean_df <- core_means %>%
  inner_join(fwhm_means,     by = c("ROI","hemi","group")) %>%
  inner_join(roi_size_means, by = c("ROI","hemi","group")) %>%
  left_join(adult_vox_base,  by = c("ROI","hemi")) %>%
  mutate(
    ROI   = factor(ROI, levels = roi_levels, ordered = TRUE),
    hemi  = factor(hemi, levels = c("lh","rh")),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("Adults","adolescents")),  # Adults under, adolescents over
    y     = clamp(y, -y_lim, y_lim),
    ecc   = pmin(ecc,  ecc_lim),
    size  = pmin(size, size_lim),
    fwhm  = pmin(fwhm, fwhm_lim),

    # Relative ROI size: Adults = 1.0
    vox_rel = totalvox / adult_vox,
    vox_rel = clamp(vox_rel, vox_rel_lo, vox_rel_hi),

    # Map relative size range to 0..1 radius for the spoke
    r_ROIvx = (vox_rel - vox_rel_lo) / (vox_rel_hi - vox_rel_lo),

    category = cat_from_roi(as.character(ROI)),
    line_col = case_when(
      category == "faces"  ~ pal_faces[as.character(group)],
      category == "bodies" ~ pal_bodies[as.character(group)],
      category == "places" ~ pal_places[as.character(group)],
      category == "words"  ~ pal_words[as.character(group)],
      TRUE ~ "#555555"
    )
  )

# ---------- Split Y into Ypos/Yneg, normalize all spokes to 0..1 ----------
norm_df <- mean_df %>%
  transmute(
    ROI, hemi, group, line_col,
    r_Ypos  = pmax(y, 0)  / y_lim,
    r_Yneg  = pmax(-y, 0) / y_lim,
    r_Ecc   = ecc  / ecc_lim,
    r_Size  = size / size_lim,
    r_FWHM  = fwhm / fwhm_lim,
    r_ROIvx = r_ROIvx
  )

# ---------- Build polygon points (clockwise: Ypos → ROIvox → Ecc → Yneg → Size → FWHM → Ypos) ----------
axes_order <- c("Ypos","ROIvox","Ecc","Yneg","Size","FWHM")

build_one_poly <- function(row) {
  vals <- c(
    Ypos = row$r_Ypos, ROIvox = row$r_ROIvx, Ecc = row$r_Ecc,
    Yneg = row$r_Yneg, Size   = row$r_Size,  FWHM = row$r_FWHM
  )
  df <- tibble(axis = axes_order, r = as.numeric(vals[axes_order])) %>%
    left_join(spokes, by = "axis") %>%
    mutate(x = r * cx, y = r * sy)
  bind_rows(df, df[1, , drop = FALSE]) %>%  # close polygon
    mutate(ROI = row$ROI, hemi = row$hemi, group = row$group, line_col = row$line_col)
}

poly_pts <- norm_df %>%
  arrange(ROI, hemi, group) %>%
  split(list(norm_df$ROI, norm_df$hemi, norm_df$group), drop = TRUE) %>%
  purrr::map_dfr(~ build_one_poly(.x[1, ]))

# Endpoints (drop the closing duplicate row)
end_pts <- poly_pts %>%
  group_by(ROI, hemi, group) %>%
  mutate(idx = row_number()) %>%
  filter(idx < max(idx)) %>%
  select(-idx) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---------- rings, rays, labels ----------
axes_df <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  ROI  = factor(roi_levels, levels = roi_levels, ordered = TRUE),
  hemi = factor(c("lh","rh"), levels = c("lh","rh"))
)

rings <- tibble(r = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0)) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(theta = seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 361)) %>%
  mutate(x = r * cos(theta), y = r * sin(theta)) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(axes_df)

rays <- spokes %>%
  mutate(x0 = 0, y0 = 0, x1 = cx, y1 = sy) %>%
  tidyr::crossing(axes_df)

end_labels <- bind_rows(
  tibble(axis="Ypos",   lab=sprintf("%d",  y_lim),         x=cos(deg2rad( 90)),  y=sin(deg2rad( 90))),
  tibble(axis="Yneg",   lab=sprintf("%d", -y_lim),         x=cos(deg2rad(-90)),  y=sin(deg2rad(-90))),
  tibble(axis="Ecc",    lab=sprintf("%d",  ecc_lim),       x=cos(deg2rad(-45)),  y=sin(deg2rad(-45))),
  tibble(axis="ROIvox", lab=vox_rel_label_max,             x=cos(deg2rad( 45)),  y=sin(deg2rad( 45))),
  tibble(axis="FWHM",   lab=sprintf("%d",  fwhm_lim),      x=cos(deg2rad(135)),  y=sin(deg2rad(135))),
  tibble(axis="Size",   lab=sprintf("%d",  size_lim),      x=cos(deg2rad(-135)), y=sin(deg2rad(-135)))
) %>% tidyr::crossing(axes_df)

lab_hjust <- function(x) ifelse(x < -1e-6, 1.05, ifelse(x > 1e-6, -0.05, 0.5))
lab_vjust <- function(y) ifelse(y >  1e-6, -0.35, ifelse(y < -1e-6, 1.35, 0.5))

# ---------- draw ----------
n_cols <- length(roi_levels); n_rows <- 2
panel_w_in <- 1.9; panel_h_in <- 1.9
w_in <- n_cols*panel_w_in + 1.2; h_in <- n_rows*panel_h_in + 1.2

out_file <- file.path(out_dir, "F6_fingerprint_polar_clockwise_ROIvxRel.png")
if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly=TRUE)) {
  ragg::agg_png(out_file, width=w_in, height=h_in, units="in", res=300)
} else {
  png(out_file, width=w_in, height=h_in, units="in", res=300)
}

ggplot() +
  # rings & rays
  geom_path(data = rings, aes(x = x, y = y, group = interaction(r, ROI, hemi)),
            color = "gray75", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(data = rays, aes(x = x0, y = y0, xend = x1, yend = y1),
               color = "gray75", linewidth = 0.6) +
  # axis-end labels
  geom_text(data = end_labels, aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab),
            size = 6, color = "gray35",
            vjust = lab_vjust(end_labels$y),
            hjust = lab_hjust(end_labels$x)) +

  # Adolescents = polygon filled 
  geom_polygon(
    data = poly_pts %>% dplyr::filter(group == "adolescents"),
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = interaction(ROI, hemi, group), fill = line_col),
    color = NA, alpha = 0.70
  ) +
  scale_fill_identity() +

  # Adults = solid line 
  geom_path(
    data = poly_pts %>% dplyr::filter(group == "Adults"),
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = interaction(ROI, hemi, group), colour = line_col),
    linewidth = 1.7, lineend = "round", linetype = "solid"
  ) +

  # endpoints (same colors; shows per-axis vertices)
  geom_point(
    data = end_pts,
    aes(x = x, y = y, colour = line_col),
    size = 2, stroke = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_colour_identity() +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(-1.12, 1.12), ylim = c(-1.12, 1.12), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  facet_grid(hemi ~ ROI, drop = TRUE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_blank(),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    axis.text        = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks       = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing.x  = unit(1.4, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y  = unit(5, "lines"),
    plot.margin      = margin(10, 24, 10, 24)
  )

dev.off()

```
